change: Structural help in the original hash-file signal: remove the service hash, leaving three hashes and one mutated password. restore: Restore the service hash and its output requirement after the student reliably solves the three-hash version; that reintroduces the second mutation pattern without changing the retained leet-variant skill.
prediction: The change addresses continued candidate expansion after John reports two easy cracks.
